name: robots/realsenseai__realsense-ros
title: RealSense ROS 2 camera
intro: RealSense ROS 2 camera, adapted from realsenseai/realsense-ros. It reads `frame_id`, `width`, `height`, `device_name` and 9 more; runs `capture_image` and `capture_point_cloud`. `capture_image`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
